question: If the mode of a data set exceeds its mean by 17.7, then the mode exceeds the median by _____. (Use empirical formula.)
solution:
**Given:**

Mode exceeds mean by 17.7

**Formula used:**

Empirical formula: Mode = 3(Median) - 2(Mean)

**Calculation:**

Using the formula, Mode = 3(Median) - 2(Mean)

Let Mean = x

Mode = x + 17.7

⇒ x + 17.7 = 3(Median) - 2(x)

⇒ x + 17.7 + 2x = 3(Median)

⇒ 3x + 17.7 = 3(Median)

⇒ Median = x + 5.9

Mode exceeds Median:

⇒ Mode - Median = (x + 17.7) - (x + 5.9)

⇒ = 17.7 - 5.9

⇒ = 11.8

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
